title: Understanding MSE Minimization
text: To minimize the Mean Squared Error (MSE) using a constant model, consider what value of $$\theta_0$$ would make the predicted values closest to the actual $$y$$ values.

title: Exploring the Mode
text: The mode is the value that appears most frequently in a dataset. Consider how using the mode as $$\theta_0$$ might affect the MSE.

title: Considering the Mean
text: The mean is the average of all $$y$$ values. Think about how using the mean as $$\theta_0$$ could influence the MSE.

title: Analyzing the Median
text: The median is the middle value when the $$y$$ values are sorted. Reflect on how using the median as $$\theta_0$$ might impact the MSE.

title: Calculating MSE for a Constant Model
text: If $$\theta_0$$ is set to a constant value, the predicted value for each data point is the same. The MSE is calculated as $$\frac{\sum \left(y_i-\theta_0\right)^2}{n}$$. Which value of $$\theta_0$$ minimizes this expression?
